name: Tankoin Tank
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: On December 20th, 2019 - January 9th, 2020 it was possible to obtain the Tankoin Tank paint if the 100 000 tankoins dropped from the coinbox.
Only 101 tankers managed to get the mega prize of 100k Tankoins.
On April 10th, 2020, the paint appeared in the garage for 100 000 tankoins.
Tankoin Tank is the most expensive paint available for purchase in the Garage.
This is the only paint that has never been discounted even during special events and is not eligible for any future discounts.

Garage description
A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
On December 20th, 2019 - January 9th, 2020 it was possible to obtain the Tankoin Tank paint if the 100 000 tankoins dropped from the coinbox.
Paint appeared on January 10, 2020.
Only 101 tankers managed to get the mega prize of 100k Tankoins.
On April 10th, 2020, the paint appeared in the garage for 100 000 tankoins.
